thread:
mira_sales: Heads-up - Nimbus Labs ready to sign POC but procurement insists on customer HSM custody, EU-only processing, and net-60. Any blockers?

jon_legal: Share their redline PDF and exact HSM wording. We should aim for attestation + limited access instead of full custody as a compromise.

mira_sales: Uploaded at https://files.redwood/contracts/nimbus_redline.pdf. They want: "Customer-managed HSMs; Redwood shall have no key access."

anya_ops: Hosted can't support exclusive customer key custody. Options: Dedicated with HSM gateway (supported) or Private. Both need EU cluster + egress lock.

kevin_eng: Timeline: Dedicated+HSM gateway ~2 weeks if procurement signs. Private ~4+ weeks. Also need attestation hook in onboarding.

paul_finance: Net-60 needs credit approval. PO on invoice is okay; we can add PO field. If they complete credit form today we can fast-track.

esign_bot: DocuSign supports sequential signing and PO field. Template available tpl_4501.

mira_sales: OK will push the dedicated option, ask them to fill credit form, and request sequential legal->CFO signers. I'll update after reply. :thumbsup:
